newsitem.title: USA: Delta has no comment on merger report.
newsitem.headline: Delta has no comment on merger report.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said on Wednesday that it had no comment on a New York Times report that the Atlanta-based carrier and Continental Airlines Inc were in talks about a possible merger.
"It is our long-standing policy that we do not respond to questions about mergers, acquisitions, takeovers or major investments," Delta spokesman Bill Berry said.
"That would be our position in regard to this particular report," he added.
The New York Times report published on Wednesday, quoting sources familiar with discussions between Delta and Continental Airlines, said no deal was imminent.
